hero.heading: The talent you need
hero.subheading: Hundreds of skilled visa holders in ICT, accounting, and marketing are actively seeking sponsorship. RedBridge handles candidate screening. Insight Idea manages the full 482 legal process.

painPoints.title: No qualified local candidates
painPoints.detail: ICT, engineering, and accounting roles consistently attract few or no suitable local applicants. Genuine experience with specific certifications is structurally scarce domestically.

painPoints.title: Extended vacancies cost real money
painPoints.detail: Every month a critical role stays open means lost productivity, increased load on existing staff, and ground lost to competitors who have already filled theirs.

painPoints.title: Compliance complexity discourages action
painPoints.detail: SBS applications, Labour Market Testing, nomination obligations, and ongoing sponsor duties feel overwhelming. With the right guidance, they don't have to be.

painPoints.title: Hard to find the right sponsored candidate
painPoints.detail: Sponsorship only works when skills, visa eligibility, and long-term commitment all align. Finding that match without a trusted network is a genuine challenge.

threePhases.heading: Three Phases: From Gap to
threePhases.subheading: Phases can run in parallel. You don't wait for one to close before the next begins.

feesTable.heading: Sponsorship Actual Costs
feesTable.subheading: Government fees are mandatory and non-negotiable. RedBridge and Insight Idea service fees are provided as a fixed quote after your role assessment.
feesTable.byLawNote: all sponsorship costs must be borne by the employer. They cannot be charged to or recovered from visa holders. Insight Idea and RedBridge service fees are quoted separately and confirmed in writing before any work begins.

fees.label: Standard Business Sponsorship (SBS)
fees.note: One-off. Not required if already an approved sponsor.

fees.label: SAF Levy: Small Business (<$10M turnover)
fees.note: Per visa year. Paid at nomination lodgement.

fees.label: SAF Levy: Large Business (≥$10M turnover)
fees.note: Per visa year. Paid at nomination lodgement.
